claims.quote: Parosphromenus linkei (“Linke’s Licorice Gourami” / “Moonspot Licorice Gourami”) is a distinctive blackwater labyrinth fish native to Central Kalimantan, Indonesian Borneo.
Parosphromenus linkei is a liquorice gourami from Central Kalimantan province in Indonesian Borneo, described from creeks near Sukamara.
